windows.intermediate_caption: The scene depicts an outdoor plaza with multiple tables and red umbrellas arranged on a paved surface, situated near a grassy hill. Behind the plaza stands a building with large windows and stairs leading up to it, set against a backdrop of distant mountains under a clear sky. For most of the duration, the area remains completely devoid of people or vehicles. At approximately 21 seconds, a person wearing a white shirt appears on the upper-level walkway of the building on the left side of the frame and proceeds to walk across it toward the right.
